question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

There is __no place__ on the bench.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2****)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"room"** means space that can be occupied or where something can be done. (जगह)

 
 
• **Example: **There is no **room** for error in this critical project.
 
 
 
• **"no room" **refers to the absence of space or capacity. (कोई जगह नहीं)
 
 
• **Example: **There is **no room **on the shelf for more books.
 
 

Hence, the phrase **'no room' **is the most appropriate substitution for 'no place' in the given sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **no life **(कोई जीवन नहीं): Absence of living beings or activity.

 
 
• **Example:** The desert showed no signs of life.
 
 
 
• **more space **(अधिक स्थान): Additional area or capacity.
 
 
• **Example: **We need more space to accommodate all the guests.
 
 
 
• **more place** (अधिक जगह): Additional location or area.
 
 
• **Example:** We need more place to store our belongings.
 
 

3e:Tc67,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**&
